title: radio extras hidden then indented
rule: Radio extras: additional fields stay hidden, then show indented under the selected radio — not a second “radios vs checkboxes” row.
pass_when: Extra fields for a radio are hidden until that radio is selected, then appear indented under it.
fail_when: Extra fields for unselected radios are visible; extras appear unindented / disconnected from the selected radio.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Radios vs checkboxes vs toggle (already filed).
